description: Share-text cleanup: removes supplier/distributor references from shared product content (WhatsApp/native share, copy, share card, public share page). Applied in order, case-insensitive, to the text only; saved product data is never changed. The Flutter app keeps an identical copy (lib/features/products/domain/share_text_cleaner.dart); test/share_text_cleaner_test.dart fails if they differ.
